products.name: Endpoint Security Baselines — Commercial
products.short_description: Apply Microsoft's recommended hardening in one move — conflict-free. Do it yourself with self-guided, tested steps for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Expert hardening, applied in one move — without the guesswork

Hardening Windows by hand means choosing among hundreds of security settings and getting some of them wrong. Security Baselines apply Microsoft's own recommended, pre-configured set of hardening settings in a single move — expert-grade posture without the guesswork — then let you customize and keep it current as Microsoft updates the baseline.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Endpoint Security Baselines. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what baselines are, the available baselines, and how they apply.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune steps including conflict detection/resolution and version updates.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — posture discovery, baseline validation, tenant reporting, conflict checking, and remediation.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A consistent, Microsoft-recommended hardening posture across the fleet — hundreds of vetted settings applied at once, conflicts resolved, and a clear path to stay current — without manual setting-by-setting work.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ESB-ConflictCheck.ps1 — list configuration/security policies that may conflict with a baseline
    • ESB-Discovery.ps1 — snapshot of the device's current security posture
    • ESB-Remediation.ps1 — force a policy sync so the security baseline re-applies
    • ESB-TenantReport.ps1 — security baseline assignment + state report (Microsoft Graph)
    • ESB-Validation.ps1 — confirm representative security baseline settings are applied

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
